newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion, Imo to merge.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion, Imo to merge.

text.p: United Dominion Industries Ltd has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Imo Industries Inc, the companies said Thursday.
Under terms of the agreement, United Dominion will start a cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of Imo at $6 cash per share.
The purchase price represents a premium of about 89 percent over Imo's average trading price of the last 90 days, Imo said. Imo shares closed at 3-1/8 Wednesday.
Including the assumption of Imo debt and closing expenses, the deal is valued at $440 million, IMO said.

United Dominion also said it had agreed to acquire Core Industries Inc's 11.1 million fully diluted common shares at $25 each. The transaction is valued at $330 million, including assumed debt and closing expenses, it said.

United Dominion and Imo said that simultaneously with the tender offer for Imo's 17.4 million fully diluted common shares, United Dominion will tender for Imo's $155 million of 11-3/4 percent subordinated debentures due 2006, at 120 percent of outstanding principal.

The total consideration for the two acquisitions is about $770 million, United Dominion said. The deals are expected to provide additional annual revenues of about $750 million on a pro forma basis, it said.
United Dominion said Core had agreed to pay it a $10 million termination fee, and Imo had agreed to pay an $8 million termination fee, both subject to certain conditions.
Both deals have the approval of the companies' boards of directors, United Dominion said.

The tender offers for Imo will begin on or before July 3 and will be followed by a merger in which each remaining Imo share will be converted into the right to receive the cash price per share paid in the tender offer.
Imo is a global manufacturer of pumps, power transmission equipment, fluid sensors, motion control products and automotive components for niche industrial markets.
Core Industries produces specialized industrial products in three segments: fluid control, test, measurement and control, and farm equipment.
